title: sudo make me a puzzle
intro: Hard mode enabled, Thomas. Good luck. 🐧

puzzles.prompt: What is the name of the penguin mascot of the Linux kernel?
puzzles.explanation: Tux was drawn by Larry Ewing in 1996.

puzzles.prompt: In the original Super Mario Bros. (NES), the infamous "Minus World" glitch is reached from which level?
puzzles.explanation: By clipping through the wall at the end of 1-2 and entering the warp pipe, you reach the endless water level "World −1".

puzzles.prompt: A group of flamingos is called a…
puzzles.explanation: A flamboyance of flamingos. (A group of crows is a murder; a group of owls is a parliament.)

puzzles.prompt: Guess the 6-letter word. Only 5 guesses — you’re welcome.
Find four groups of four that share something in common.
puzzles.explanation: MAN is a command (and part of Pac-Man!), CATfish is a red herring, and a WORD is a unit of data.
